scheme_name: Unemployment Allowance To The Educated Unemployed Persons With Disabilities
other_conditions: Must be a person with disability (any category except Intellectual Disabilities as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016)
Must have a minimum qualification of Matriculate
Must be registered with the Special Employment Exchange for more than two years
Must not be placed in any gainful occupation
Must be a Manipuri by birth or have settled in Manipur for at least ten years
benefits_summary: Unemployment allowance of ₹400 to ₹1,000 per month.
documents_required: Application form (downloadable from www.socialwelfare.nic.in or obtainable from District Social Welfare Offices)
